hooks.name: Balance check on ruleset save
hooks.description: When a ruleset in rulesets/ is saved, ask Kiro to validate it and re-run the quick balance check with the neurisko MCP tools

action.prompt: The designer saved a Monster Mash ruleset in rulesets/. Use the neurisko MCP tools on the saved file: run check_ruleset; if it is invalid, list the errors and stop. If it is valid, run quick_balance and compare with the previous quick_balance result in this conversation, if there is one. Report in at most 5 lines: dominant and underused units with shares, baseline and seed count, and what changed since the last check. Do not edit the file.
